extra_quotes: From the fit parameters, we determine a cavity finesse of F = π √ F 2 ≈ 17.
The corresponding quality factor is given by Q = mF ≈ 1.5 × 103, where m = 2L/λ ≈ 90 is the longitudinal mode order for a cavity length of L = 45 mm at an operating wavelength of approximately 1 mm.
This corresponds to a FWHM resonance linewidth of ∆fFWHM ≈ 200 MHz, relevant for potential bandpass filtering applications.
First, in addition to the fundamental axial modes, fainter diagonal trajectories corresponding to higher-order transverse modes are visible.

Second, the transmitted intensity fluctuates along the axial mode trajectories, producing regions of high and low intensity due to differential transmission along the fast and slow axes of our 3D-printed QWPs.
